summary: Lenox Mountain lookout: 1915 tower, 1966 and 1970 replacements, cab burned 1995; frame now carries communications gear and the tower is closed to climbers.

facts.design: 68-foot tower built fall 1970; original lookout cab and stairs destroyed by fire in 1995
facts.status_note: Frame stands, but the lookout cab and stairs burned in 1995; decommissioned for lookouts and used to host communications equipment.

staffing.status: last staffed in the 1988 fire season

access.note: 2026 trail guide: tower is closed to climbers and fenced off; a viewpoint lies just past the summit

visit.trail_note: The summit loop passes an outstanding viewpoint just past the summit; the tower itself is closed to climbers.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: NHLR names the Massachusetts Bureau of Fire Control; the Former Fire Lookout Sites entry names the U.S. Forest Service. The story follows the register and notes the difference.
NHLR gives 75 feet; an April 1970 North Adams newspaper says 80-foot. Both are reported.
NHLR gives fall 1970; a March 1971 state notice of bids calls for construction of a fire tower on Lenox Mountain. The notice may be a later contract; not resolved.
NHLR says last staffed in the 1988 fire season; the 2026 trail guide says decommissioned for lookouts in 1998. Both are reported.
NHLR places it on Lenox Mountain in Berkshire County; the 1971 notice says Richmond, and the trail guide calls it the Richmond Fire Tower. Not resolved.

notes_for_editor: NHLR is the main source; the Forest Lookouts history is built from newspaper clippings. The 2026 trail guide is the only current source. The brief's height of 24.4 m conflicts with the register's 68 ft (corrected). Elevation differs slightly between NHLR (2,126 ft) and FFLOS (2,123 ft); not used. Search snippets about a 2003 rebuild plan and a steel frame were not fetched and are not used. Fact-check 2026-10-08: every story claim was checked against the cited pages and matches. One evidence entry was missing (the Nov 1969 '100 feet' claim) and has been added. Several sentences that repeated source wording were reworded. The pending corrections (status) are left for human review as STORY_GUIDE.md requires.
